html:
Hop on your skates and jump into a physics based hockey game. No rules, no timeouts, just get the puck in the goal. May the best team win!

Puck is Free to Play

Puck is and always will be a Free to Play title. Cosmetic elements such as stick skins, hats, custom player numbers, etc. will be introduced over time to cover the costs of keeping the Puck servers alive.

Competitive

Showing your skills and earning your ranks among other Puck players is a feature planned in the close future. Hop into competitive matchmaking and get matched against players of similar skill level to yours to keep the gameplay fair and fun!
